_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is statistically extreme (0/64 windows moved ±2+ points) and neither brain has identified a live directional breaker — HOLD with conviction is the skilled call, with Disbelief as the logical next rung if spot sentiment begins recovering from Fear & Greed at 29.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both agree on HOLD signal and coiled compression, but split on whether the August analog is valid (Analyst rejects, Narrative embraces) and on forward direction (Analyst neutral, Narrative implies upside).
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows sustain above 40 for 3+ days with btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d falling below 85 and funding remaining below 60
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows remain below 15 while btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d stays above 95 and long_short_pct_30d breaks 95 — confirming coil extends with eventual downside resolution as overleveraged longs unwind
